questions.text: In a class definition with 10 methods, to make the class maximally cohesive, number of direct and indirect connections required among the methods are
questions.solution:
Maximum cohesion: every pair of methods is directly connected, so no indirect connections are needed.

Direct connections = [latex]\binom{10}{2}=45[/latex], indirect = 0.

Answer: 45, 0

Cyclomatic complexity = number of decision points + 1.
Decisions: while-1, while-2, and the if [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 3.

V(G) = 3 + 1 = 4

Answer: 4

questions.text: What is the defect rate for Six sigma?
questions.solution:
Six Sigma quality means at most 3.4 defects per million opportunities (here, lines of code).

Answer: 3.4 defects per million lines of code

questions.text:
What is the availability of the software with the following reliability figures
Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) is 20 days
Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) is 20 hours
questions.solution:
MTBF = 20 days = 480 hours, MTTR = 20 hours.

Availability [latex]=\frac{MTBF}{MTBF+MTTR}=\frac{480}{500}=0.96=96\%[/latex]

Answer: 96%

questions.text: Regression testing is primarily related to
questions.solution:
Regression testing re-runs tests after changes (bug fixes, enhancements) to make sure nothing that worked before is broken. This happens mainly during maintenance.

Answer: Maintenance testing
